canonical_title: Yaw rate response to small roll commands

versions.title_at_revision: Yaw rate response to small roll commands
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle's yaw response to small roll inputs is no worse than Level 2 as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Yaw Response to Small Roll Control Commands paragraph, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the air vehicle's yaw response as specified in MIL- STD-1797, Yaw Rate Response to Small Roll Control Commands paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle's yaw response as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Yaw Rate Response to Small Roll Control Commands paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle's yaw response as specified in MIL- STD-1797, Yaw Rate Response to Small Roll Control Commands paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
